name: Kagaku to Mahou no Kasou Sekai Vol. 5
original_name: 科学と魔法の仮想世界Vol.5
source:
The day after helping out freshman Ruka, admin in the virtual world sends Akira notice of user permission in another area. Akira immediately goes to Krusniev, where the permission originated. But there, the troubling deed of a group chasing around a young girl was reported.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE138921.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在帮助新生Ruka的第二天，虚拟世界的管理员向Akira发送了另一个区域的用户许可通知。阿基拉立即前往许可的来源地克鲁斯涅夫。但在那里，有报道称一群人追逐一名年轻女孩的令人不安的行为。
